description: Condition-based DC KCL: non-linear optocoupler and gate-driver timing not simulated.

cases.name: LPV off, software transistor forced on; opto dark at 25 C datasheet point
cases.assumption: 100 nA max only IF=0, VCE=20 V, 25 C; no full-temperature or actual-bias guarantee

cases.name: LPV off, hardware overvoltage active
cases.assumption: hard-path transistor VCE=0.2 V assumed; opto not in this path; actual UCC action also requires valid early rail and GUARD_OK high

cases.name: LPV on, PB7 high, both series transistors assumed saturated
cases.assumption: 0.2 V each assumed, not a guaranteed operating point; needed current exceeds 1 mA optocoupler VCEsat test

cases.name: negative control: LPV cutoff transistor bypassed, PB7 high
cases.assumption: Q_DUMP_SW VCE=0.2 V assumed; represents original fault topology

limits.serial_led_assumptions: hypothetical internal LED series: 4.75V, 515.1Ω, Vf 1.65V + 1.4V, MOS 0.1V; Vf values specified at different larger test currents, not guaranteed at actual operating current

warnings: BMS LED path is not exposed; insertion requires BMS redesign; adding load on shared FOC output also violates unverified interface.
No full-temperature/low-VCE CTR, leakage, fault timing or LED current guarantee; current comparisons are not qualification.
LPV high with local 5V lost remains unblocked; no complete solution.
Independent early hard rail and comparator validity, plus retention through regenerative tail, are assumptions.
